description.en:
I became a maid inside of a horror game.
Penalties were given to the male lead, who was trying to escape being locked up in a large mansion, and I acted as a guide. 

I was going to fulfill my duties until the male lead’s play ends.

“When I get out, I’ll lock you up exactly the same way.”

The male lead is so noisy. 
If it’s going to be like this, I’ll just help him escape faster. 

“Let’s eat, Dietrich.”
“This is a potion, it’ll help you recover faster if you take it.”
“The hint to escape is over there…”

I fed him well to prepare for the next play, and when the male lead got hurt, I gave him a potion so he could quickly play the next game,
I even gave him a hint for the problem. 

You’ll be able to get out now, right?

However. 

“I don’t really know the answer.”

What’s the meaning of this? Aren’t you supposed to be smart?

…The male lead doesn’t think about leaving the mansion at all. 

“If you won’t get out, I will.”

I shouted in anger because I was so sick of the thought of having to see the face of someone I don’t want to keep seeing. 

“Is it possible for you to get out of here?”

His eyes sank bitterly. 

“Let me tell you this, I have no intention of leaving this place.”
“What?”
“And you have no way of getting out, either.”

What the hell is going on?

Unfortunately, among the good celestials who handed out blessings to humans in return for their faith, there were evil celestials who preferred to use more powerful means to just take over Earth.

description.en:
I was a rabbit shapeshifter who couldn't even transform into a human by my coming of age ceremony. My family said that I was just a halfling and placed me in a basket…

"You're crying? Go on, cry more."

Then I was then picked up by a black panther with an awful personality.

"You're lacking in fighting spirit. I'll eat you the day after tomorrow, so keep trying."

This fierce beast. Staring at my trembling face, the black panther's eyes glistened.

"How thrilling."

Mom, I think he's crazy! To survive a fairly crazy black panther.

"The wild beasts are possessive, no matter what it is."

…Is it possible?

---
Vivi is a... wererabbit?! As a creature that’s supposed to transform into a human, Vivi is a failure, demonized as cursed and sent off to her doom. Luckily, her demise is cut short as Ahin of the Black Leopard Clan saves her. But with every threat and command this temperamental heir tosses at Vivi, she’s questioning her safety (and sanity). Surrounded by carnivores and their strong pheromones, she'll try to survive the chaos while stuck in her rabbit form. Will she figure out how to transform and tap into the power within her cute, furry self?

What’s going to happen to me?!

description.en:
Lim Jeongah used to be an ordinary grad student living in South Korea. After reading the novel *The Flower From Another World*, late into the night, she wakes up as Empress Robellia le Castilla, the wife of the tyrant Alexandros the Second. Though Jeongah had felt sorry for Robellia while reading the novel, she never wanted to become her. Alas, Jeongah must accept her new reality and find a way to divorce her husband. At first, she thinks this will be easy, as the emperor is always cold toward Robellia and only expresses affection to his consort in the novel. However, every act of trying to get Alexandros to agree to a divorce piques his curiosity instead. Will Jeongah succeed at getting the happy, solo life she wished for Robellia to have?

---
I possessed the Empress in the romance novel. Isn't that supposed to be good? But the problem is that this Empress is always pushed around by the deceitful Empress, treated badly by the Emperor, and she eventually died from an illness. However, unlike the original Empress, I cannot die in vain. I have to become a villain in order to divorce the tyrant husband.

description.en:
"You're the older sister — just let it go. Can't you even do that for her?"  
  
Irene has always been living in the shadow of her ill and frail sister, Riel. She believed that she could and had to do everything for her family… until Riel stole everything from her.  
  
After realizing that there is no place for her in her home, and that she was never loved by her family, Irene decides to do her utmost to become independent, and in doing so, crosses paths with Noel Kristen, a man who has been subjected to a much similar fate…  
  
"We may be able to save each other."  
  
Promotional webtoon for the novel of the same name.

description.es: "Como eres hermana mayor, tienes que cederle el paso a tu hermana". "¿Tu hermana no puede concederlo por su hermana?" Irene pensó que podía hacer cualquier cosa por su familia. Hasta que su hermana se lo llevo todo. “No me llames hermana. Ahora no soy tu hermana. " "Ahora, ¿qué le vas a decir a tu hermana?" "¿Por qué Riel no se sacrifica por mí? Dejé todo por Riel ”. Un día, se da cuenta de que no tiene lugar en su casa. Y el hecho de que nunca fue amada por su familia. "No quiero arrepentirme más". Irene, últimamente consciente de su situación, encuentra la manera de ser independiente. Frente a ella, Noel Kristan, un gran príncipe que se encuentra en una situación similar, aparece….. * * * "¿Vas a casarte conmigo?" "Según sea necesario". "Temerario. Si quieres algo como una gran anfitriona, es bueno que te des por vencido ". "No necesitas poder ni amor." Noel la miró en silencio, había una atmósfera extraña en ella. Tal vez podía hacerlo.

She possessed Charlotte Lania, an extra character that was not even mentioned much in the original. She thought the bloody socialite world and politics were only stories from another world. That was until she accidentally met the male lead’s younger brother and saved him.

Theodore Heinst. The younger brother of the male lead, who was supposed to die at the age of three.

If she didn’t save him, she could be accused of an assassination attempt and accomplice to a crime. In the end, Charlotte decided to take good care of the child and clear her name.

However–

“Theo wants to live with you!”

The little kid started to refuse to go back home and yet, “Can you be the Lady of the Heinst House?”

Carlisle "Carcel" Heinst, the male lead, who was supposed to marry the original female lead, proposed to Charlotte a contract marriage. Goodbye, peaceful extra character life.

---

Charlotte Rania thought she'd be free to enjoy her life as an unimportant side character... until she saves a dying boy, who turns out to be Theodore Heinst, the younger brother of the male lead! Despite her reluctance to get involved with said male lead, Duke Carlyle Heinst, Charlotte has no choice but to help him when she discovers that mysterious forces are trying to kill Theodore. It doesn't take long for her to realize that changing a character's fate comes at a price...

Аделаида Серджио никогда не знала роскоши, пока не переродилась дочерью богатого графа. Она была нацелена на получение семейного наследства, но внезапная помолвка её коварной сестры разрушила все её планы. Имея всего две недели на то, чтобы найти мужа, Адель отправилась на поиски в священный храм и среди священных рыцарей обнаружила, что их командир - идеальный мужчина! Он красив, порядочен... и совершенно не заинтересован в помолвке. 
Управится ли Адель с холодным командиром вовремя, или золотая ложка будет выдернута из её рта?

---
Я хочу сражаться за наследство, а не получать подачки с барского плеча! Нужно накалить отношения между родителями и их детьми.

— Брат, я прошу повышения.

И таким образом, моя жизнь нищенки номер один во всей Корее подошла к концу. Во второй главе своей жизни я родилась дочерью магната! К тому же, я наследница рода Серджио, властвующего над всем Югом! Хотя быть сестрой злодейки достаточно хлопотно, но разве это важно? В конце концов, я должна была унаследовать титул. Но всё пошло наперекосяк, когда моя младшая сестра воткнула мне нож в спину, чтобы расстроить мои планы.

Осталось две недели до возвращения отца. За это время мне нужно как-то выйти за лучшего мужчину в империи! И вот так начались поиски подходящей партии. Если ты молод, способен и привлекателен, то так даже лучше! Хотя поиски займут некоторое время… ну и пусть. В любом случае это брак по контракту, так что кандидату и не обязательно соответствовать всем критериям!

Seung-ah, que trabalha para a empresa de cosméticos, recentemente participou do concurso Hotel Amenity realizado no Seojin Hotel como um projeto de equipe, mas não conseguiu sair das preliminares.  
  
Seung-ah e seus colegas de trabalho que trabalharam arduamente neste concurso chegaram a um acordo para encontrar os funcionários do Seojin Hotel.  
  
De alguma forma, quando eles descobriram que havia algo entre Seung-ah e Seo Jin-hyung, o sucessor do Seojin Hotel, durante o tempo em sua universidade, todos eles contaram com ela.  
  
Na verdade, Seung-ah confessou a Jin-hyung porque ela o amava sem ser correspondido na faculdade, mas ela não gostou porque tinha uma dolorosa memória de ter sido dispensada. Mas, ela tomou coragem para a empresa e entrou em contato com ele.  
  
Claro, ela pensou que seria rejeitada, mas Jin-hyung aceitou o encontro e deu as boas-vindas a Seung-ah no dia em que finalmente se conheceram.  
  
Jin-hyung trouxe à tona a história do concurso do Seojin Hotel e disse, "Seung-ah, eu me apaixonei por você!"  
  
Por que um belo herdeiro chaebol, que não deveria ter nada com que se preocupar, faria isso comigo?!  
  
Por favor, aguardem o romance cósmico alegre e animado de Seung-ah!

description.en:
*Note: This is a promotional oneshot.*
___
After I finished my SAT’s I was reading a novel about the pitiful Ludia who had no partner. The friend of the stalker villainess, who gets her executed. The pushover who followed her friend that brought her doom, also known as extra 1. …Why do I remember an extra who’s of no importance?   
  
Damn it, I became that Ludia! I made up my mind that I won’t die miserably and live on but…  
  
Hello, crown prince.  
Why are you straying away from the female lead, and keep getting entangled with me?  
And why does he get so delusional!!  
  
“What should I do? What if the crown prince really fell in love with me…”  
“Hm, that would never happen.”  
“Why?”  
“He was with me last night.”  
  
Since it happened this way, I might as well just snatch this man?!

When I opened my eyes after a fire, I became a side character in a novel. What am I to do now?  
  
Get closer to the heroine? No.   
Get closer to the male lead? No.  
I’m going to live a long and simple life!  
  
I’ve lived peacefully outside the Emperor’s castle for 3 years. I thought I would be free as long as the novel ended happily as it should.  
  
“Who’s th-…”  
“Servant.”  
  
Huh?  
  
“I’ll listen to your every command.”  
“H-Huh?”  
“If I listen to whatever you say, can we live together?”  
  
The servant who came into my easy life.  
I live a happy life with him. Sometimes he’s a kind servant, and other times, a dear friend…The problem is, I can’t seem to take my eyes off him when he smiles saucily and flirtatiously with those red eyes.  
…Is it because of my feelings?  
  
The 30th concubine, Lydia, whose goal is to live a long and simple life and the suspicious servant begin a strange relationship as they start living together.

Back to when she had been divorced by Crown Prince Mikael Alanquez, the reason why her father lost his life. As revenge, Reinhardt stabbed the Crown Prince’s leg. While she was on her rough journey, she encountered someone unexpected… The dirty, pitiful kid she picked up, in the previous time-line, was not only a war hero, but the emperor's illegitimate child — the "mad dog" whom her ex-husband had tamed.

description.fr:
«Père, s'il vous plaît, donnez-moi une chance de le découper.»

Juste avant de mourir, Reinhardt a répété les mêmes mots que ceux qu'elle avait souhaités. Lorsqu'elle reprit ses esprits, elle se retrouva aux funérailles de son père, il y a 15 ans. C'était l'époque où elle venait de divorcée du Prince Michelle, la raison pour laquelle son père avait perdu la vie. Pour se venger, Reinhardt a poignardé la jambe du prince héritier. Et par conséquence, elle a été exilée. Pendant son dur voyage, elle a rencontré quelqu'un d'inattendu...

«Êtes-vous vraiment Bill Corona?»

Elle a ramassé le pauvre enfant sale. Dans sa vie antérieure, il était le chien du prince héritier. Il était un héros de guerre pour son ex-mari. Une grande opportunité s'est présentée dans le cœur de Reinhardt qui avait soif de vengeance. Elle donne un nouveau nom à l'enfant et décide de l'utiliser pour sa vengeance. Elle ne gâchera jamais cette vie. Tout en construisant une forteresse pour faire revivre le domaine, le garçon part à la guerre... Trois ans passèrent et celui qui s'appelait Wilhelm était devenu un homme. Il n'était plus l'enfant qu'elle avait élevé.

«Comme vous l’avez dit... Je suis revenu, et je reviendrai toujours vivant, alors donnez-moi la récompense pour mon retour.»

«Q-quel genre de récompense?»

Le sourire du garçon, ou plutôt de l'homme, s'assombrit et lui donna une réponse qu'elle n'attendait pas.

«Vous.»

«Moi?»

«Oui, Rein.»

Sa voix douce résonnait dans l'oreille chauffée de Reinhardt.

«Je vous aime, Rein.»

Reinhardt était plongée dans un concept compliqué appelé amour. Et avec ça, Reinhardt avait envie de s'étrangler.

description.en:
"To stay alive… I have no choice but to become a genius. From today, I’ll do my best, so please support me." 
Lee Hyun-woo finds himself possessing Kyle Seltarion, an extra character from a game where he used to reign as the world’s number one player.  
Considering the game’s storyline, he soon faces the imminent death of Kyle, who, on top of being on death's door, can't use magic or aura and has a terrible reputation. How did he end up in the body of such a character?  
However, after discovering a new talent, he learns to harness mana and begins to shift his attributes and reputation with knowledge of hidden routes gained through grinding in the game.  
His immediate goal is to save his own life, but that goal is closely linked to the impending global catastrophe...  
To overcome this situation, he needs to gather allies and boost his reputation! It's time to turn his past, which was a reckless mess, around and move into a new phase!

In this prequel to *Mookhyang: Dark Lady*, we meet Mookhyang in Murim, or the world of martial arts, as a young member of the Demonic Sect. After years of rigorous training, he rises through the ranks and joins an elite squad of first-rate assassins. Despite his impressive achievements, however, he finds himself hungry for more. His obsession for martial arts ultimately leads him down a different path… one that few have ever dared to take. He spends decades learning the way of the sword and cultivating his inner qi, or mana, in hopes of one day reaching a state no warrior of the Demonic Sect has ever reached before—the State of Demon Transcender. Join Mookhyang as he fights powerful masters, takes down evil forces, and pushes himself to the limit... and beyond.

"내가 이엘린이 된 이상, 이렇게 억울하게 당하면서 악역으로 살아갈 순 없어."
"원작 속 주인공들과 엮이지만 않으면 되겠지."

분명 완벽한 계획이라 생각했다.
그러나,

"이엘린, 또 도망가면 꽁꽁 묶어서 황자궁으로 데려가 버리겠어."

여주만 바라보아야 할 2황자가 내게 집착하기 시작하더니,

"딱히 널 생각해서 그런 건 아니니 착각하지 마라."

내 라이벌이란 이놈은 마치 날 짝사랑하는 듯한 눈으로 쳐다보기 시작했고,

"까악! 이엘린님, 너무 아름다워, 세상에서 제일 멋있으셔!"
"저분 마법에 한 번 맞아봤으면…!"

갑자기 날 추종하는 팬클럽이 생기질 않나,

"자! 우리 모두 이엘린님의 사진을 보며 경건한 마음으로 기도합니다."

원작 여주가 내 팬클럽 회장이 되어 버렸다.
너네 …날 이렇게 좋아해도 되는 거야?

나, 악역인데?!

description.en:
One day I woke up and I was six years old. I had transmigrated into the main character of a tragic novel, Saint Priscilla, who walks through all sorts of thorny paths! Since I’m here, I need to avoid the scheduled special misfortune and live happily with my favorite character. The final boss of the story and the villain, Melchizedek, the tyrant of the Rehel Empire, who has no blood or tears! A happy life of adopting my father and becoming a princess, with my favorite character. I also saved the male protagonist, in order to remove my father’s death flag.

“If you approach my daughter, you will die.”

Why does my father keep putting up death flags?

Moreover… “If you tamed me, you have to take responsibility.”

Why is the male lead so obsessed with me? What’s going on?

---
One day, a girl awakens as 6-year-old St. Priscilla, the heroine of her most cherished novel. The catch? She is destined to suffer with an abusive adoptive family! To avoid this, she adopts her ultimate bias, the ruthless Emperor Melkiades, as her father instead. Although spending her days fangirling and redeeming her bias's tarnished name seems like a dream come true, with so many foes still lurking in the shadows, can this young saint protect Melkiades and find happiness for them both?
description.fr:
Je me suis réveillée un matin en me retrouvant dans la peau d'une enfant de six ans. Il semblerait que j'ai transmigré en personnage principal d'un roman tragique. La *Sainte Priscille* qui fait face à d'innombrable situations épineuses. Puisque je suis ici, je dois éviter les souffrances qui m'attende et vivre une vie heureuse avec mon personnage préféré: L'antagoniste, Melkiade, le tyran de l'empire Rehel! Avec lui comme père, je compte mener une vie digne d'une princesse ! Mais jamais rien ne ce passe comme prévue dans ce genre histoires... «Si tu t'approches de ma fille, tu es mort.»

---
Amelia renaît dans son roman préféré en tant qu'héroïne. Le seul problème? C'est une sainte destinée à souffrir, mais quand vient le moment du rituel, elle décide de prendre les choses en main: Miltiades serait son père. Bien qu'il soit le méchant du roman, cela ne veut pas dire qu'il serait un père horrible. Mais alors qu'elle pensait bientôt vivre une fin heureuse avec son père au palais, un obstacle se dresse sur son chemin: le héros destiné à anéantir le méchant. Il semble qu'elle doive les apprivoiser tous les deux si elle veut vivre heureuse.
description.ko:
어느 날 눈을 뜨니 여섯 살이 되어있었다.
내가 빙의한 건 온갖 가시밭길을 걷는 피폐 소설 속 주인공, 성녀 프리실라!

이왕 이렇게 된 거, 예정된 특급 불행을 피하고 최애캐와 행복하게 살아야 한다.
작중 최종 보스이자 악당,
피도 눈물도 없는 레헬 제국의 폭군, 멜키아데와 함께!

아빠를 입양해서 공주도 되고, 최애캐 덕질도 하는 행복한 인생.
아빠의 사망 플래그도 제거할 겸, 겸사겸사 남주인공도 구해줬는데...

아빠는 왜 이렇게 자꾸 사망 플래그를 꽂는 거지?

어쩐지 남주까지 내게 집착하는데, 이게 어떻게 된 거지...?

description.en:
Heroine has traveled back in time and entered the universe of *Lady and the Beast*, a 19th century soft porn trashy novel. She finds herself in the body of Anthea, child bride of the Monster Crown Prince Blake, who has been cursed to die at the age of 18 due to this sins of his ancestor. In the novel, Anthea should have committed suicide after looking at the horrible cursed birth marks on Prince Blake's body. But she tries to rewrite a part of the story by instilling confidence in Blake and showering him with unconditional love, just until he is ready to meet his "real" true love, Diana.

---
She transmigrated into the body of Ancia, the current wife of the monstrous crown prince, Blake, in an R-19 romance novel.

In the original story, Ancia committed suicide on the day of their marriage, leaving Blake with massive trauma. But this time, Ancia wouldn’t do such a thing.

Blake was the second male lead in the original novel. He was portrayed as a beast that possessed an exquisite facade. Yet, right now, he was behaving just like an innocent rabbit.

The only person who can remove the crown prince’s curse is the heroine, Diana. My role is to just keep this little boy from getting hurt and then step down in time, but...

“Ancia, don’t leave me!”

This little rabbit keeps chasing me.

description.en:
Emilone, once a successful actress but after traveling dimensions, she became a Saintess. This feat got her the decent nickname of ‘the lady who traveled dimensions’ but she didn’t receive any special attention. Because all the attention in the Empire went to Princess Ronella Nestro.

While devoting herself to her work as a Saintess, Emilone accidentally discovered the secret of Princess Nestro:

The Princess’s kind and innocent appearance was all an act!

‘This could be quite interesting.’

If she got closer to Princess Nestro, maybe her boring life wouldn’t be so boring after all. Emilone made a dangerous decision for fun.
description.id: Aku adalah seorang aktris populer sebelum aku datang ke dunia ini dan menjadi Emilone, seorang Saintess. Aku diberi julukan "wanita yang berpindah dimensi". Meski begitu, aku tidak mendapat perhatian khusus. Semua perhatian tertuju pada Putri Ronella Nestro. Akibatnya, Aku memutuskan untuk mengabdikan hidup ku untuk menjadi Orang Suci. Suatu hari, aku tidak sengaja menemukan rahasia Putri. Kepribadian sang Putri yang lugu dan baik hati hanyalah akting! Ini mungkin menarik. Aku mungkin bisa menghentikan rutinitas saya yang membosankan jika aku lebih dekat dengan Putri Ronella. Aku memutuskan untuk membuat keputusan berbahaya untuk bersenang-senang.
description.ko:
'공녀의 하렘 속 남자들이 내게 다가온다.'

낯선 세계로 소환되어 성녀가 된 에밀로네. 제국의 잘난 귀족 남자들은 모두 순진하고 가녀린 네스트로 공녀를 좋아한다. 어느 날, 에밀로네는 사랑을 듬뿍 받던 공녀의 모습이 가짜였다는 걸 알게 되고 이에 흥미를 가지자 하렘 속 남자들이 에밀로네를 주시하기 시작하는데...
description.pl:
Byłam popularną aktorką, zanim przyszłam na ten świat i zostałam Emilone, Świętą. Nadano mi przydomek „dama, która przeniosła wymiar”.

Mimo to nie poświęcono mi szczególnej uwagi. Cała uwaga skupiona była na księżniczce Ronelli Nestro.

W rezultacie zdecydowałam się poświęcić swoje życie byciu Świętą.

Któregoś dnia przypadkowo odkryłam sekret księżniczki. Niewinna i dobroduszna osobowość księżniczki była udawaniem!

„To może być interesujące.”

Może uda mi się przerwać moją nudną rutynę, jeśli zbliżę się do księżniczki Ronelli.

Zdecydowałam się podjąć niebezpieczną decyzję dla zabawy.
description.uk:
Емілоне була відомою акторкою до того, як потрапила в інший світ і стала святою. Вона отримала правдоподібне ім'я «Свята, яка перемістилася між вимірами», але це не привернуло жодної уваги. Це сталося тому, що вся увага імперії була прикута до принцеси Ронелли. У результаті Емілоне, яка була віддана своїй роботі як свята, випадково відкрила таємницю принцеси Ронелли. Невинні та добрі образи принцеси були всього лише грою!

— Це може бути досить весело. Хіба я не зможу порушити свою нудну рутину, якщо наближуся до принцеси Ронелли?

Емілоне прийняла небезпечне рішення заради розваги.

description.en:
Minjun Kim, an ordinary high school senior in Korea, was suddenly summoned to another world, where he became a dark mage.

Determined to return home, he overcame all sorts of hardships and saved the other world with black magic before leaving all his wealth and glory as a hero behind to return to Earth.

However, before he could fully enjoy his life, a problem arose. A dungeon break had occured and monsters came pouring out, threatening his comfortable days.

Therefore, Minjun, who had just returned to earth, had no choice but to… enlist on the very next day!!!
description.pt-br: Minjun Kim, um simples estudante do ensino médio na Coreia do Sul, foi subitamente convocado para outro mundo, onde se tornou um mago negro. Determinado a retornar para casa, ele enfrentou todo tipo de adversidades e salvou o outro mundo com magia negra antes de abrir mão de toda sua riqueza e glória como herói para voltar à Terra. No entanto, antes que pudesse desfrutar plenamente de sua vida, um problema surgiu: uma quebra de masmorra ocorreu e monstros começaram a surgir, ameaçando seus dias tranquilos. Portanto, Minjun, que acabara de retornar à Terra, não teve outra escolha senão... alistar-se no exército no dia seguinte!!!

I've lived in this little hell ever since I was born for being the daughter of a gypsy who carries misfortune. The Trump Empire killed my innocent mother. The emperor, the temple, and the whole empire locked me up, abused me, resented me, and abandon me. Their abandonment is an opportunity, Here in the kingdom of Jardine, I will begin my revenge. The Trump Empire, may it dry up a little more. The dryness will soon be a precious stream for me. …I will start my revenge.

---
Branded as a cursed child, Princess Osiria spent most of her life locked in an attic. In actuality, Osiria is the divinely chosen, the one who could’ve saved the empire of Trionfo. Instead, she was sold to a neighboring kingdom and left in the care of Sir Fedelius, a handsome young knight. Although her heart beats faster when Fedelius is around, she doesn’t plan on staying for long. She wants only one thing… to get revenge on those who abused her and killed her mother. Will her heart soften with love or will she seek vengeance to the very end?

description.en: Having lost his ranked account to a hacker, Kang Yoohan wants to get even. Assuming his lost equipment was sold, he’s hoping that as blacksmith Zig, it will come back to him through repairs and lead him to the hacker. After breaking many swords, however, he finds this is no walk in the park. Thankfully, he’s able to see cracks in the equipment and enemies that show their vital points to make or break them! Armed with these skills, Zig is looking to get things shaking, or rather, smithing!

description.en:
A few years ago, the Second Queen Nayla incited a rebellion. The King and the First Queen, Viatan, along with their aides, were all killed. Only Princess Chell, the daughter of Viatan survived.

The Princess, now lives like a ghost, and is known as the Princess of Death.

Along comes Penny, who becomes Chell's personal maid, making her the first maid that serve the Princess after years. However, she's no ordinary maid.

This blunt and clumsy maid is actually an assassin disguised as a maid. Under the orders of Queen Nayla, Penny's final task is to kill the Princess. 

Penny just wants her freedom. She needs to save money to escape and travel far away after she finishes her final task from Queen Nayla.

Unlike the rumours about being the Princess of Death, Penny finds herself inexplicably drawn to the Princess.

Will Penny be able find her way to freedom?

description.de: Iseop Tae hat alles - Erfolg, Reichtum und Einfluss. Denn er ist der Erbe und zukünftiger Besitzer der TK-Gruppe, einem der größten Unternehmen des Landes. Nur Glück in der Liebe hatte er bisher nicht. Sein Alltag wird auf einen Schlag auf den Kopf gestellt, als Mingyeong Kang, eine erfolgreiche Abteilungsleiterin der TK-Gruppe, zur Privatsekretärin von Iseop degradiert wird. Iseop ist so gar nicht davon begeistert, Mingyeong, die mit ihm im selben Ausbildungsjahrgang war und ihn immer übertrumpft hat, so dicht an seiner Seite zu haben. Und auch Mingyeong hält Iseop für einen verwöhnten Snob. Doch warum muss er immer wieder an sie denken? Können die beiden ihre Differenzen beiseite legen?
description.en:
In his entire life, Lee Seop pursued to become a capable heir of the number one firm in Korea, TK Group. But his efforts were in jeopardy when a genius man manages to take control of the core business in the firm. Frustrated with his own incapabilities, he planned to retaliate in a nonsensical way. Meanwhile, Mikyeong, a top elite in the firm was assigned to work with him.

Note: This series is the spin-off sequel to the novel, 태연한 거짓말 which featured Junseop (Iseop's cousin) as the protagonist.

---

From Webtoon:
With her outstanding business acumen, Mingyeong Kang climbed the corporate ranks of TK Group, Korea’s top conglomerate, to become a senior manager in record time. But after 10 years at the company, she’s been assigned to be the secretary of Iseop Tae, the successor to TK Group. The two entered the company at the same time, but ever since he came second place to her at new employee training, Iseop’s never taken kindly to Mingyeong. She’s better than him in every way and trampled all over his ego… so why can’t he stop thinking about her?
description.ja: 10年連続ノルマ達成率１位！史上最速で出世コースに乗った超エリート社員！ ずっと１位の座を独占してきた俺に初めて２位の屈辱を味わせた同期、浅野由紀。 俺のプライドを踏みにじったあいつが突然俺の秘書に…？ そのスキルで俺まで手の中で転がそうってか？ 仕事はもういいから、こっち向いてくれよ浅野さん！ やる気０、超脱力系な司とやる気1000、意欲メラメラ系な由紀のはちゃめちゃオフィスロマンス！
description.ko:
1등만 해 온 나에게 첫 2등의 경험을 안겨준 입사동기, 강민경.
내 자존심을 짓밟은 그녀가 나, 태이섭 전무의 비서가 됐다.
그 뛰어난 업무처리 능력으로 나까지 처리해 버리려고?
업무 그만 하시고 여기 좀 봐주시죠, 강민경씨!
아무것도 하기 싫은 태이섭과 어떻게든 해내야 하는 강민경의 대환장 오피스 로맨스!
description.tr:
Tae Iseop, tüm hayatı boyunca Kore’nin bir numaralı firması TK Grup’un varisi olma hedefiyle 34 yıl boyunca yalnız bir hayat yaşar. Ancak aynı yaştaki kuzeni ve rakibi olan Tae Joon Seob ile rekabetinde ezici bir şekilde yenilmektedir.

Kang Minkyung, TK yöneticisi olma yolunda sağlam bir şekilde yürüdüğünü sanıyordu.
Ta ki kendisinden ısrarcı ve sinir bozucu bir kişiliğe sahip TK’nin varisi Tae Iseop’a ​​yardım etmesi istenene dek.
Hiçbir şey yapmak istemeyen Tae Iseop ile bir şeyler yapmak zorunda kalan Kang Minkyung arasındaki etkileyici ofis aşkı!
description.pt-br: Com sua excelente visão de negócios, Mingyeong Kang subiu as fileiras corporativas do Grupo TK , o principal conglomerado da Coreia, para se tornar gerente sênior em tempo recorde. Mas depois de 10 anos na empresa, ela foi designada para ser a secretária de Iseop Tae, o sucessor do  Grupo TK. Os dois entraram na empresa ao mesmo tempo, mas desde que ele ficou em segundo lugar para ela no treinamento de novos funcionários, Iseop nunca foi gentil com Mingyeong. Ela é melhor do que ele em todos os sentidos e pisoteou todo o seu ego… então por que ele não pode parar de pensar nela?
description.zh-hk: 姜敏京，蟬聯10年業績冠軍、年紀輕輕便步步高升的最優秀職員！讓一直都是第一的我初次嘗到了第二名的滋味，如此踐踏我尊嚴的她，竟然即將成為我太以燮的私人祕書？難不成是想用她那超越人類的頂尖業務能力把我一起處理掉嗎？——自暴自棄的太以燮vs.野心勃勃的姜敏京，顛覆你想像最精彩刺激的辦公室戀情！

description.ar: لقد مضت ست سنوات منذ بدء اللعبة لتحديد مصير العالم. الملك البطل كانغ يو سونغ، أقوى لاعب لم يهبط من مركز هداف الدوري مرة واحدة، يرحب بالموسم الجديد أيضا. “لقد… انتهيت منذ وقت طويل. إنني أفعل ذلك فقط من أجل المال.” [مستوى التذمر قد أزداد بشكل كبير!] [يعرب شيخ اليقطين عن إرتياحه لتصرفات اللاعب!] ان طريقة النجاة للاعب الموهوب المجنون تتكشف الآن!

description.es: Areum ha caído en un mundo extraño llamado 'Soltera' después de un accidente automovilístico. La confunden con un vampiro por el color de su cabello, y un traficante de esclavos la vende a la casa de un duque. ¡La identidad de Millard Travis, el maestro de la casa del duque que la compró, es el único vampiro del mundo! Desesperado por sobrevivir de cualquier manera, Areum se convierte en el sirviente directo de Millard, jurando servirle como su maestro. description.fr:
Après un accident de voiture, Areum débarque dans un monde étrange, répondant au nom de Soltera. Les gens la prennent alors pour une vampire à cause de la couleur de ses cheveux, et elle est vendue à la maison du Duc par un marchand d'esclaves. Il s'avère alors que Millard Travis, le maître de maison, qui est également celui qui l'a achetée, est le seul et unique vampire de ce monde!

Prête à tout pour survivre, Areum devient la servante directe de Millard, jurant de le servir. Elle décide d'être une servante dévouée jour après jour, si bien que l'attitude de Millard commence progressivement à changer...
description.ko:
갑작스러운 사고로 이(異) 세계로 오게 된 소녀와 
그곳의 유일한 흡혈귀 공작의 스릴 넘치는 로맨스 판타지!
교통사고를 당하고 '솔테라'라는 낯선 세계로 떨어진 아름. 머리카락 색 때문에 흡혈귀라고 오인당한 그녀는 노예 상인에 의해 공작가에 팔려간다. 그녀를 산 공작가의 가주 밀러드 트래비스는 이 세계의 유일한 흡혈귀!
어떻게든 살아남고 싶은 아름은 밀러드를 주인으로 깍듯이 모시겠다고 맹세하며 그의 직속 하녀가 된다. 하루하루 주인의 비위를 맞추는 아름의 정성에 밀러드의 태도가 변하기 시작한다.
description.vi: Sau một vụ tai nạn xe hơi, Areum bị rơi vào một thế giới kỳ lạ tên là "Soltera". Ở đây, họ nhầm cô là một ma cà rồng do màu tóc đen; Areum sau đó bị bắt làm nô lệ rồi bị bán cho một vị công tước. Trớ trêu thay, cô lại được bán cho một ma cà rồng chính hiệu - Công tước Millard Travis, ma cà rồng duy nhất trên thế giới này! Không còn lựa chọn nào khác, Areum đành phải cắn răng phục vụ cho chủ nhân. Mỗi ngày trôi qua dưới sự hầu hạ của cô, anh chàng ma cà rồng bắt đầu thấy cô hầu này cũng hay đấy.

Will Linda be able to find her mother and return to her homeworld?

When the game unexpectedly merges with reality, Yuujun finds himself in the game world with access to his massive virtual inventory. Now, with his amassed power and resources, he is more than ready to navigate this new reality...or is he?

Our protagonist has reincarnated as Han Siha, a minor villain in the dark fantasy novel he once loved. 

To live a peaceful life without getting tangled up with the protagonists, graduating from the academy is a must. But for Han Siha, who has no magical talent and terrible social skills, this is an almost impossible task. Taming, however... it might be possible.

Alright, let’s just focus on making it to graduation like this! But then... the protagonists who were supposed to kill him in the original story are now starting to take an interest in him?! 

Can Han Siha really graduate safely?

An overworked girl strikes gold, waking up as wealthy noblewoman Yvonne Argentrose in a novel. Once a jealous villainess one-sidedly obsessed with the crown prince, now all she wants is a peaceful and opulent life. Still unconvinced of her transformation, her family tries to set her up with the empire's perfect man, Duke Ehels. But when the once uninterested crown prince catches wind of this, he becomes jealous, and drama ensues! Can Yvonne escape the drama and enjoy her new life in peace?

description.en:
Julia, who was born an orphan, was killed in exchange for falling in love with the Young Master of the Marjoram Family. But when she opened her eyes, at the same location as any other day, she was rescued by the Commander of the Imperial Army, ‘Carus’... She was hit by a curse of being unable to die, and this is now her eighth life. After realizing that she would be stuck in the loop forever if she didn't take down the Marquis, she became a servant within the Palace to utilize the Royal Family’s power to demolish the Marjoram Family in her eighth life. “Isn’t this how we’re supposed to plot revenge?”

---
Commoner orphan Julia Arte is cursed with repeatedly dying and being reborn on the same snowy mountain trail. Now on her ninth life, she is determined to break the curse by getting revenge on her former lover Vasily Marjoram, who not only left her to die but sent assassins to kill her. After becoming the second lady-in-waiting to House Marjoram's sworn enemy, Prince Lewisia Ortega, Julia pulls out all the stops to take down Vasily. But will her scheming bring more trouble than she bargained for?
description.fr:
Julia est assassinée par des tueurs à gages envoyés par la maison du marquis Marjoram, pour avoir osé aimer le jeune maître de cette noble famille.
Mais à chaque fois qu’elle ouvre les yeux, elle se retrouve au même jour, au même endroit, toujours sauvée par Karus, le commandant des forces impériales.
Frappée par une malédiction l’empêchant de mourir, elle a vécu ce moment huit fois.
Ce n’est que lorsqu’elle comprend qu’elle ne pourra jamais mourir tant qu’elle n’aura pas anéanti la maison Marjoram, qu’elle décide, dans sa neuvième vie, de devenir une dame de compagnie au palais royal, dans le but de faire tomber ses ennemis...

---
La vengeance ne s'accomplit-elle pas ainsi? Julia, une orpheline roturière, est assassinée par des tueurs engagés par le marquis Majoram pour avoir aimé son fils. Mais à chaque fois qu'elle revient à la vie, elle est sauvée par le commandant de l'armée impériale ‹Karus›, le même jour, au même endroit... La malédiction veut qu'elle ne meure pas ainsi, sa vie s'est répétée huit fois de cette manière. Maintenant, dans sa neuvième vie, elle cherche à devenir une servante du palais royal afin de déclencher la mort de Majporam, par les mains de la Famille Royale.
description.it: L'orfana comune Julia Arte è maledetta con la morte e la rinascita ripetute sullo stesso sentiero innevato di montagna. Ora alla sua nona vita, è determinata a spezzare la maledizione vendicandosi del suo ex amante Vasily Marjoram, che non solo l'ha lasciata morire, ma ha anche mandato degli assassini a ucciderla. Dopo essere diventata la seconda dama di compagnia del nemico giurato di Casa Marjoram, il principe Lewisia Ortega, Julia tira fuori tutti gli assi nella manica per abbattere Vasily. Ma i suoi intrighi porteranno più guai di quanti si aspettasse?

description.ru:
Юлия, рожденная сиротой, была убита за любовь к молодому господину семьи Майоран.

И каждый раз, открывая глаза, она оказывается в том же дне, когда её спасает командующий имперской армией – Карус…
Проклятие не даёт ей умереть и вот настал черёд девятой жизни.

Поняв, что эта бесконечная петля не закончится, пока она не прикончит маркиза, Юлия решает стать служанкой во дворце, чтобы уничтожить Майоран силами императорской семьи.

House Francesca holds a secret. There's an imposter within the house who seeks revenge. But who could it be? Is it the late duke's greedy sister who loathed sharing the riches of the duchy but loved spending them on herself? One of the duke's brothers, both of whom were hungry for the power that the duke held? Or could it be his daughter, who was under a spell to kill those who got in her way? Duchy of Francesca memerintah provinsi utara atas nama keluarga Kekaisaran yang jatuh. Setelah kematian mendadak tuan rumah tangga mereka, Duke Den, si kembar Damian dan Chloe menjadi boneka di tangan kerabat mereka. Dikendalikan oleh sihir gelap, Damian menjadi penguasa rumah tangga yang bercangkang kosong sementara Chloe, yang memiliki bakat alami dalam ilmu pedang, menjadi seorang pembunuh yang berulang kali melakukan pembunuhan yang tidak diinginkan. Kemudian dianggap tidak lagi berguna, dia jatuh ke sihir hitam dan membunuh Damian dengan tangannya sebelum menemui akhir tragisnya sendiri sesudahnya. Namun, ketika dia membuka matanya sekali lagi, dia kembali ke masa lalu. Ke masa lalu - hari ayah tercintanya, pemakaman Duke Den. Sejak saat itu, Chloe mengambil keputusan. Keputusan untuk tidak membiarkan kehidupan masa lalunya terulang kembali .. dan untuk menghukum kerabatnya dan pengikut yang berani meninggalkan keluarganya.
